title: Iniesta 2010 v Modrić 2018: the World Cup winner or the World Cup loser?
checked: Dani Jarque, Espanyol captain, died 8 August 2009 aged 26 (Wikipedia, Guardian); Iniesta's T-shirt tribute 'Dani Jarque siempre con nosotros' after his final goal, and his later account of a dark 2009-10 with injuries (Guardian, Wikipedia Iniesta). La Liga 2009-10 Barcelona 99, Real 96, Valencia 71 (Wikipedia). Spain lost 0-1 to Switzerland, then won R16, QF and SF 1-0 v Portugal, Paraguay, Germany (Wikipedia 2010 World Cup, FIFA). Final: Heitinga sent off in the 109th minute, Iniesta's 116th-minute winner from Fabregas, man of the match (Wikipedia final, UEFA, UPI). 2010 FIFA Ballon d'Or: Messi, Iniesta, Xavi (Wikipedia, ballondor.com). 2018: Real 3-1 Liverpool; France 4-2 Croatia; Golden Ball; Ballon d'Or Modric 753, Ronaldo 476, Griezmann 414 (Wikipedia, FIFA, ballondor.com). Gameplay: Iniesta's winner recreated with gamecap (spec iniesta-2010).

lines.text: One scored the goal that won a World Cup. The other lost a World Cup final. Guess who won the Ballon d'Or.

lines.text: August 2009. Espanyol's captain, Dani Jarque, Iniesta's friend, dies suddenly. He was twenty-six.

scene.headline: Espanyol captain Dani Jarque dies aged 26
scene.standfirst: The centre-back collapsed at the club's pre-season camp in Italy. Football in Spain is in mourning.

lines.text: Barcelona still win the league, with ninety-nine points.

lines.text: Now the twist. In 2010, the man who won the World Cup came second. Messi won it.

lines.text: In 2018, the man who lost the final won it, and ended ten years of Messi and Ronaldo.

lines.text: Iniesta had the moment of a lifetime. Modrić had the better season. Settled: Modrić.
